text:
Ravi: Hey team, migrating from zsh -> fish on my M2. I installed asdf via brew but fish doesn't see the shims. Also 1Password ssh agent socket path is different and VS Code terminal in Insiders can't access it. Any tips?
Nora: welcome Ravi! Fish needs its own asdf init. Add `source (brew --prefix asdf)/libexec/asdf.fish` to `~/.config/fish/config.fish`. That will create fish shims.
Ravi: did that but `node` still points to system. I think PATH ordering is wrong when launching GUI apps.
Nora: put `/opt/homebrew/bin` in `~/.config/fish/config.fish` before other paths: `set -x PATH /opt/homebrew/bin $PATH`. For GUI apps on mac, also add the same export to `~/.zprofile` so login shells used by apps inherit it.
Ravi: thanks, PATH fixed node. About 1Password: its SSH agent exports `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` at a user-specific socket. Fish wasn't picking it up on launch so VS Code Insiders couldn't forward it.
Nora: in fish, add `if test -n "$SSH_AUTH_SOCK"; set -x SSH_AUTH_SOCK $SSH_AUTH_SOCK; end` or explicitly source the 1Password helper in config. For Insiders/VS Code, ensure the app is restarted from the terminal (so the environment is inherited) or use `envFile` in your devcontainer settings to pass the socket path.
Ravi: restarted Insiders from terminal and now `ssh-add -l` in the integrated terminal shows my key. One last thing: our monorepo has multiple `.tool-versions` in subpackages; asdf only respects root file. Any recommended pattern?
Nora: common approach: keep a root `.tool-versions` that pins shared runtimes, and for per-package overrides use `.tool-versions` in package dirs plus a tiny `direnv` rule to run `asdf local` when you cd into those folders. Or use a short wrapper script that symlinks the right `.tool-versions` during CI.
Ravi: sweet. everything green now. thanks! :raised_hands:
